title: Procurement Invoice Anomaly at Apex Technologies
description: Internal finance audit flagged an unapproved $48,000 vendor disbursement request for network switches.

clues.title: Approved Purchase Order PO-8820
clues.content: Official procurement document PO-8820 authorizes the purchase of 20 managed network switches from NetStream Solutions at $1,200 each, totaling $24,000.

clues.title: Vendor Invoice INV-904
clues.content: Vendor NetStream Solutions submitted invoice INV-904 requesting $48,000 for 40 managed network switches, citing PO-8820 as authorization.

clues.title: Dock Delivery Manifest
clues.content: Warehouse freight manifest confirms delivery carrier dropped off exactly 20 sealed hardware cartons from NetStream on October 14 at 11:15 AM.

clues.title: Warehouse Floor Note (Contradiction)
clues.content: Assistant warehouse manager signed an internal intake sheet asserting 40 switch cartons were received and moved into secure cage B on October 14 at 11:15 AM.

clues.title: Facilities Maintenance Log (Irrelevant)
clues.content: Facility maintenance records show HVAC filter unit on the third floor east wing was replaced during quarterly maintenance.

clues.title: Vendor Billing Correction Notice
clues.content: NetStream Solutions accounts director sent an email stating INV-904 was a duplicate automated system billing error caused by an ERP migration, and only 20 switches were shipped under revised invoice INV-904-A for $24,000.

clues.title: Physical IT Asset Count
clues.content: Internal IT audit lead physically inspected secure storage cage B and verified exactly 20 serial-numbered NetStream switches in packaging.

clues.title: Revised Invoice INV-904-A
clues.content: Accounts Payable logged receipt of corrected invoice INV-904-A from NetStream for 20 units totaling $24,000 matching PO-8820.

clues.title: Duplicate PO Confirmation
clues.content: Official procurement document PO-8820 authorizes the purchase of 20 managed network switches from NetStream Solutions at $1,200 each, totaling $24,000.

clues.title: Banking Wire Hold Notice
clues.content: Corporate treasury confirmed the automated ACH disbursement of $48,000 was intercepted and canceled prior to settlement.
